mine.title: My trips
mine.emptyBody: Start one now: mark places on the map and sort them into days.
mine.failed: Your trips could not be loaded.
mine.moreFailed: More trips could not be loaded.

form.title: Title
form.destinationHint: Optional. Pick a suggestion to open the map there, or just type a name.
form.rangeDays: {count, plural, =0 {No days} one {# day} other {# days}}
form.dayCountHint: From 1 to {max}. You can add or remove days later.

errors.titleRejected: This title was not accepted. Try another one.
errors.destinationTooLong: Use at most {max} characters for the destination.
errors.destinationRejected: This destination was not accepted. Try another one.
errors.endBeforeStart: The last day cannot come before the first.
errors.rangeTooLong: A trip has at most {max} days.
errors.dayCountInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {max}.
errors.limitReached: You have reached the limit of {max} trips. Delete one to create another.
errors.offline: No connection. Check it and try again.
errors.unexpected: The trip could not be saved. Try again.

details.heading: Details
details.descriptionHint: Optional, up to {max} characters. Shown to whoever can see the trip.
details.descriptionRejected: This description was not accepted. Try another one.
details.startDateHint: Optional. The number of days changes in the planner.
details.failed: The changes could not be saved. Try again.
details.offline: No connection. Check it and try again.

link.label: By link
link.hint: Anyone with the link. Never listed in Explore.

public.label: Public
public.hint: Listed in Explore. Your notes and dates stay hidden.

share.label: Share link
share.hint: Whoever opens it sees the trip without your notes or dates.
share.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
share.shareFailed: The link could not be shared.
share.rotateBody: The current link stops working at once. Anyone who has it will need the new one.
share.rotated: New link created. The old one no longer works.
share.rotateFailed: A new link could not be created. Try again.
share.rotateOffline: No connection. Check it and try again.
share.nowPrivate: The trip is private now, so it has no link.

duplicate.heading: Duplicate
duplicate.body: Make a private copy of this trip with the same days and places, without notes or dates.

danger.heading: Delete trip
danger.body: Deleting removes the days, places, notes and share link for good.

copy.limitReached: You have reached the limit of trips. Delete one to copy another.
copy.failed: The trip could not be copied.
copy.offline: No connection. The trip was not copied.

delete.title: Delete “{title}”?
delete.body: This cannot be undone. Days, places, notes and the share link are deleted with it.
delete.failed: The trip could not be deleted. Try again.
delete.offline: No connection. The trip was not deleted.
